verses.sloka: अथोवाच महातेजा हरिराजो महाबलः ।किमियं व्यथिता सेना मूढवातेव नौर्जले ।। ६.५०.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athovāca mahātejā harirājo mahābalaḥ ।kimiyaṁ vyathitā senā mūḍhavāteva naurjale ।। 6.50.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Extremely brilliant and mighty Sugriva looking at the army of Vanaras said, "Why are you worried like a boat tossed by wind in water?"
translations.hindi: ॥ घोर बाणबन्धन में बँधे हुए और सर्प की तरह फुफकारते हुए, दोनों दशस्थकुमार रुधिर से तरबतर पड़े हुए थे

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रो ऽङ्गदो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ६.५०.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāliputro 'ṅgado 'bravīt ।। 6.50.2 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Sugriva's question, Angada the son of Vali said, "Did you not see Dasaratha's sons Rama and chariot warrior Lakshmana, the great souls lying on a bed of arrows bathed in blood?"
translations.hindi: मंहाबली सुग्रोव प्रमुख समस्त बानरश्रष्ठ उन दोनों बीरों को चारों ओर से घेर कर उनकी रक्षा कर रहे थे और शोक में डूबे हुए थे

verses.sloka: न त्वं पश्यसि रामं च लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् ।शरजालाचितौ वीरावुभौ दशरथात्मजौ ।शरतल्पे महात्मानौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ ।। ६.५०.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na tvaṁ paśyasi rāmaṁ ca lakṣmaṇaṁ ca mahābalam ।śarajālācitau vīrāvubhau daśarathātmajau ।śaratalpe mahātmānau śayānau rudhirokṣitau ।। 6.50.3 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Sugriva's question, Angada the son of Vali said, "Did you not see Dasaratha's sons Rama and chariot warrior Lakshmana, the great souls lying on a bed of arrows bathed in blood?"
translations.hindi: इतने में वीयवान्‌ तथा पराक्रमी श्रीरासचन्द्र जी नागपाश से जकड़े हुए होने पर भी, सचेत हुए । मानों सो कर जागे हों

verses.sloka: अथाब्रवीद्वानरेन्द्रः सुग्रीवः पुत्रमङ्गदम् ।नानिमित्तमिदं मन्ये भवितव्यं भयेन तु ।। ६.५०.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athābravīdvānarendraḥ sugrīvaḥ putramaṅgadam ।nānimittamidaṁ manye bhavitavyaṁ bhayena tu ।। 6.50.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Vanara king Sugriva looking at Angada said, "I do not think that the Vanaras running like this is not without any cause. Maybe out of fear of some reason ahead."
translations.hindi: ऑर उठते ही) रुधिर से तर, दीनवदन और अति वि षण्ण भाई लक्ष्मण को देख, वे आतुर हो, रोने लगे

verses.sloka: विषण्णवदना ह्येते त्यक्तप्रहरणा दिशः ।प्रपलायन्ति हरयस्त्रासादुत्फुल्ललोचनाः ।। ६.५०.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanā hyete tyaktapraharaṇā diśaḥ ।prapalāyanti harayastrāsādutphullalocanāḥ ।। 6.50.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Here, the distressed Vanaras with sad faces, their eyes downcast, are fleeing in all directions abandoning their arms."

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यस्य न लज्जन्ते न निरीक्षन्ति पृष्ठतः ।विप्रकर्षन्ति चान्योन्यं पतितं लङ्घयन्ति च ।। ६.५०.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: anyonyasya na lajjante na nirīkṣanti pṛṣṭhataḥ ।viprakarṣanti cānyonyaṁ patitaṁ laṅghayanti ca ।। 6.50.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "Without waiting to look back at others, not shy to see one another, the Vanaras are distancing themselves from those fallen and are seen fleeing."
translations.hindi: इस संसार में खोजने पर सीता के समान स्री भले ही मिल जाय, किन्तु लक्ष्मण के समान भाई, सहायक और चतुर योद्धा नहीं मिल सकता

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः ।सुग्रीवं वर्धयामास राघवं च निरैक्षत ।। ६.५०.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vīro gadāpāṇirvibhīṣaṇaḥ ।sugrīvaṁ vardhayāmāsa rāghavaṁ ca niraikṣata ।। 6.50.7 ।।।।

translations.english: In the meantime, heroic Vibheeshana holding mace came to Sugriva and Rama and cheered with victory.

verses.sloka: विभीषणं तं सुग्रीवो दृष्ट्वा वानरभीषणम् ।ऋक्षराजं समीपस्थं जाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ।। ६.५०.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaṁ taṁ sugrīvo dṛṣṭvā vānarabhīṣaṇam ।ṛkṣarājaṁ samīpasthaṁ jāmbavantamuvāca ha ।। 6.50.8 ।।।।

translations.english: Beholding Vibheeshana, the Vanaras fled, said Sugriva to the great Jambavan who stood near him.

verses.sloka: विभीषणो ऽयं सम्प्रप्तो यं दृष्ट्वा वानरर्षभाः ।विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्ता रावणात्मजशङ्कया ।। ६.५०.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇo 'yaṁ samprapto yaṁ dṛṣṭvā vānararṣabhāḥ ।vidravanti paritrastā rāvaṇātmajaśaṅkayā ।। 6.50.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibheeshana has come here. Beholding him the foremost of the Vanaras fleeing suspecting him to be the son of Ravana."

verses.sloka: शीघ्रमेतान् सुसन्त्रस्तान् बहुधा विप्रधावितान् ।प्रर्यवस्थापयाख्याहि विभीषणमुपस्थितम् ।। ६.५०.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śīghrametān susantrastān bahudhā vipradhāvitān ।praryavasthāpayākhyāhi vibhīṣaṇamupasthitam ।। 6.50.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "Call them back who are running in different directions quickly. Tell them Vibheeshana has come here."

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु जाम्बवानृक्षपार्थिवः ।वानरान् सान्त्वयामास सन्निरुध्य प्रधावतः ।। ६.५०.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīveṇaivamuktastu jāmbavānṛkṣapārthivaḥ ।vānarān sāntvayāmāsa sannirudhya pradhāvataḥ ।। 6.50.11 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva having spoken in that way, the king of Bears, Jambavan restored the confidence of Vanaras.
translations.hindi: माता सुमित्रा का उलाहना मुझसे सह्य न होगा । अतएव यहीं पर शरीर त्यागना ठीक है-में अब जीवित नहीं रहना ' चाहता

verses.sloka: ते निवृत्ताः पुनः सर्वे वानरास्त्यक्तसम्भ्रमाः ।ऋक्षराजवचः श्रुत्वा तं च दृष्ट्वा विभीषणम् ।। ६.५०.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te nivṛttāḥ punaḥ sarve vānarāstyaktasambhramāḥ ।ṛkṣarājavacaḥ śrutvā taṁ ca dṛṣṭvā vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.50.12 ।।।।

translations.english: Having heard Jambavan, all the Vanaras finally shed their fear and returned to see Vibheeshana.
translations.hindi: मुझ पापी अनार्य को धिक्कार है, जिसके लिए लक्ष्मण, मृतक समान शरशय्या पर पड़े सो रहे हैं

verses.sloka: विभीषणस्तु रामस्य दृष्ट्वा गात्रं शरैश्चितम् ।लक्ष्मणस्य च धर्मात्मा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ।। ६.५०.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu rāmasya dṛṣṭvā gātraṁ śaraiścitam ।lakṣmaṇasya ca dharmātmā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ ।। 6.50.13 ।।।।

translations.english: On seeing the body of Rama and Lakshmana fully covered by arrows, Vibheeshana also became piteous and sad.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण ! बडाता था, तब तुम मुझे धीरज बँधाते थे। त पु 203 ढुःखी हो राहे, तब तुम निर्जीव के समान होने के कारण मुझसे बातचीत नहीं हा

verses.sloka: जलक्लिन्नेन हस्तेन तयोर्नेत्रे प्रमृज्य च ।शोकसम्पीडितमना रुरोद विललाप च ।। ६.५०.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jalaklinnena hastena tayornetre pramṛjya ca ।śokasampīḍitamanā ruroda vilalāpa ca ।। 6.50.14 ।।।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, wetting his hands with water cleaned the eyes of Rama and Lakshmana. Tormented with pain he cried aloud.
translations.hindi: हे बीर ! तुमने जिस संग्रामभूमि पर बहुत से राक्षस मार कर सुला दिए थे, इ भूमि पर तुम शत्रुद्वारा बाणों से घायल हो स्वयं पड़े सो रहे हो

verses.sloka: इमौ तौ सत्त्वसम्पन्नौ विक्रान्तौ प्रियसंयुगौ ।इमामवस्थां गमितौ राक्षसैः कूटयोधिभिः ।। ६.५०.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: imau tau sattvasampannau vikrāntau priyasaṁyugau ।imāmavasthāṁ gamitau rākṣasaiḥ kūṭayodhibhiḥ ।। 6.50.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Both the princess, who are endowed with good nature, and power are fond of combat. The Rakshasas have reduced them to this state by their deceitful ways."
translations.hindi: इस बाणशय्या पर पड़े हुए और अपने रक्त से तर तुम्हारे शरीर में बाण ही बाण देख पड़ते हैं । इस समय तुम अस्ताचल- गामी सूयं की तरह जान पड़ते हो

verses.sloka: भ्रातुः पुत्रेण मे तेन दुष्पुत्रेण दुरात्मना ।राक्षस्या जिह्मया बुद्ध्या चालितावृजुविक्रमौ ।। ६.५०.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātuḥ putreṇa me tena duṣputreṇa durātmanā ।rākṣasyā jihmayā buddhyā cālitāvṛjuvikramau ।। 6.50.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "The princess who were guileless in their prowess were cheated by my evil minded and stupid son of my brother by his crooked thinking and cheating."
translations.hindi: र तुम्हारे ममस्थल बाणों से विधे हुए हैं, इसोसे तुम बोल नहीं।सकते ; पर तुम्हारे नेत्रों की लालिमा देखने से जान पडता है क्रि, तुम 'प्रत्यन्त पीड़ित हो रहे हो

verses.sloka: शरैरिमावलं विद्धौ रुधिरेण समुक्षितौ ।वसुधायामिमौ सुप्तौ दृश्येते शल्यकाविव ।। ६.५०.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śarairimāvalaṁ viddhau rudhireṇa samukṣitau ।vasudhāyāmimau suptau dṛśyete śalyakāviva ।। 6.50.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "Pierced with arrows, fully covered with blood, the bodies of the two princes appear like porcupines sleeping on the ground."
translations.hindi: हे महाद्युति ! जिस प्ररार वन में आजे के मेरे महाद्युति ¦ समय तुम मेरे पीछे पीछे आये थे ; उसी प्रकार मैं भी तमा छे दद i हार.पी य को चलू गा

verses.sloka: ययोर्वीर्यमुपाश्रित्य प्रतिष्ठा काङ्क्षिता मया ।तावुभौ देहनाशाय प्रसुप्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ ।। ६.५०.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yayorvīryamupāśritya pratiṣṭhā kāṅkṣitā mayā ।tāvubhau dehanāśāya prasuptau puruṣarṣabhau ।। 6.50.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "These two bulls among men of great valour and fame whose refuge was sought by me are lying asleep wounded all over and limbs broken."
translations.hindi: यद्यपि इनको सभी भाइयों से प्रेम है; तथापियहसदा सेरे ही साथ रहते थे। सो मुक दुष्ट की उरी के छ को ठुनीतिः के कारण यह इस दृशा को प्राप्त हुए हैं

verses.sloka: जीवन्नद्य विपन्नो ऽस्मि नष्टराज्यमनोरथः ।प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञश्च रिपुः सकामो रावणः कृतः ।। ६.५०.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jīvannadya vipanno 'smi naṣṭarājyamanorathaḥ ।prāptapratijñaśca ripuḥ sakāmo rāvaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 6.50.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having lost my life ambition for the kingdom, frustrated I am. My enemy Ravana, having succeeded in his vow, did this deed."

verses.sloka: एवं विलपमानं तं परिष्वज्य विभीषणम् ।सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नो हरिराजो ऽब्रवीदिदम् ।। ६.५०.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ vilapamānaṁ taṁ pariṣvajya vibhīṣaṇam ।sugrīvaḥ sattvasampanno harirājo 'bravīdidam ।। 6.50.20 ।।।।

translations.english: To Vibheeshana who was lamenting in that way, Sugriva, who was endowed with good qualities embraced him and spoke.
translations.hindi: ये लक्ष्मण पाँच-पाँच-ती बाण एक वार छोड़ते थे; अतः बाण चलाए की विद्या में ये कार्तवीयॉर्जुन से भी बढ़ कर निपुण थे

verses.sloka: राज्यं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ लङ्कायां नात्र संशयः ।रावणः सह पुत्रेण सकामं नेह लप्स्यते ।। ६.५०.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rājyaṁ prāpsyasi dharmajña laṅkāyāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ।rāvaṇaḥ saha putreṇa sakāmaṁ neha lapsyate ।। 6.50.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "O righteous one! there is no doubt that you will attain the kingdom of Lanka. Ravana and his sons will not attain what they desire."
translations.hindi: इन्द्र के चलाए अज्रों को अपने अखों से नष्ट करने.की{जिन महाबली में शक्ति थी और जो बड़ी बढ़िया सेजों पर सोने योग्य - थे, सो आज भूमि पर मरे हुए पड़े हैं

verses.sloka: न रुजा पीडितावेतावुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ ।त्यक्त्वा मोहं वधिष्येते सगणं रावणं रणे ।। ६.५०.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na rujā pīḍitāvetāvubhau rāghavalakṣmaṇau ।tyaktvā mohaṁ vadhiṣyete sagaṇaṁ rāvaṇaṁ raṇe ।। 6.50.22 ।।।।

translations.english: "Both these heroes Raghava and Lakshmana wounded and pained having shaken off from their unconscious state will kill Ravana and his army in war."
translations.hindi: देखो राक्षसों का राज्य मैंने विभीषण को देने के लिए कहा था किन्तु मैं उसे दे नहीं पाया॥ सो यहःमिथ्याभाषण ही: मु मे निस्सन्देह भस्म कर डालेगा

verses.sloka: तमेनं सान्त्वयित्वा तु समाश्वास्य च राक्षसम् ।सुषेणं श्वशुरं पार्श्वे सुग्रीवस्तमुवाच ह ।। ६.५०.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamenaṁ sāntvayitvā tu samāśvāsya ca rākṣasam ।suṣeṇaṁ śvaśuraṁ pārśve sugrīvastamuvāca ha ।। 6.50.23 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus, consoling and pacifying, the Rakshasa, Vibheeshana in that manner, Sugriva turned to his uncle Sushena and spoke.
translations.hindi: हे सुग्रीव ! अब तुम यहाँ से इसी समय किष्किन्धा को लौट जाओ । क्योंकि मैं अब वलहीन हो गया हूँ । अतएव रावण तुमको असहाय पा कर, तुम्हारा तिरस्कार करेगा

verses.sloka: सह शूरैर्हरिगणैर्लब्धसञ्ज्ञावरिन्दमौ ।गच्छ त्वं भ्रातरौ गृह्य किष्किन्धां रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.५०.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saha śūrairharigaṇairlabdhasañjñāvarindamau ।gaccha tvaṁ bhrātarau gṛhya kiṣkindhāṁ rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.50.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "On regaining consciousness, take the brothers Rama and Lakshmana, the tamers of enemies to Kishkinda accompanied by the heroic monkey army."

verses.sloka: अहं तु रावणं हत्वा सपुत्रं सहबान्धवम् ।मैथिलीमानयिष्यामि शक्रो नष्टामिव श्रियम् ।श्रुत्वैतद्वानरेन्द्रस्य सुषेणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५०.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tu rāvaṇaṁ hatvā saputraṁ sahabāndhavam ।maithilīmānayiṣyāmi śakro naṣṭāmiva śriyam ।śrutvaitadvānarendrasya suṣeṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 6.50.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "On killing Ravana and his sons along with his kin, I will on my part also bring Mythili just as Indra recovered his prosperity."

verses.sloka: दैवासुरं महद्युद्धमनुभूतं सुदारुणम् ।तदा स्म दानवा देवान् शरसंस्पर्शकोविदाः ।। ६.५०.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: daivāsuraṁ mahadyuddhamanubhūtaṁ sudāruṇam ।tadā sma dānavā devān śarasaṁsparśakovidāḥ ।। 6.50.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the words of Vanara Lord, Sushena spoke about the fierce and great war that he had experienced between Devas and asuras.
translations.hindi: दान ने युद्ध में जैसी बहादुस दिखाई है, वह दूसरों के पिर भ जाम्बवान्‌ ओर ऋषभ के कार्यों सेमी ` अङ्गदेन कृतं कमं मैन्देन द्विविदेन च | युद्ध केसरिणा संख्ये घोर सम्पातिना कृतम्‌

verses.sloka: निजघ्नुः शस्त्रविदुषश्छादयन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः ।। ६.५०.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nijaghnuḥ śastraviduṣaśchādayanto muhurmuhuḥ ।। 6.50.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the Rakshasas adept in using arms went about agitating concealing themselves, attacking Devatas who were learned in using arms."
translations.hindi: र, ते es बहाठुरी के काय किए हैं

verses.sloka: तानार्तान्नष्टसञ्ज्ञांश्च परासूंश्च बृहस्पतिः ।विद्याभिर्मन्त्रयुक्ताभिरोषधीभिश्चिकित्सति ।। ६.५०.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tānārtānnaṣṭasañjñāṁśca parāsūṁśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।vidyābhirmantrayuktābhiroṣadhībhiścikitsati ।। 6.50.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "Brhaspati, the priest restored the wounded and lifeless, unconscious by means of reciting mantras, prayers and treatment by herbs."

verses.sloka: तान्यौषधान्यानयितुं क्षीरोदं यान्तु सागरम् ।जवेन वानराः शीघ्रं सम्पातिपनसादयः ।हरयस्तु विजानन्ति पार्वतीस्ता महौषधीः ।। ६.५०.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tānyauṣadhānyānayituṁ kṣīrodaṁ yāntu sāgaram ।javena vānarāḥ śīghraṁ sampātipanasādayaḥ ।harayastu vijānanti pārvatīstā mahauṣadhīḥ ।। 6.50.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let Sampati and Panasa go quickly to the milky ocean in a swift phase to get those medicines."

verses.sloka: सञ्जीवकरणीं दिव्यां विशल्यां देवनिर्मिताम् ।। ६.५०.३० ।।.५०.२ ।। सम्पातिपनसादयः ।चन्द्रश्च नाम द्रोणश्च क्षीरोदे सागरोत्तमे ।अमृतं यत्र मथितं तत्र ते परमौषधी ।। ६.५०.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sañjīvakaraṇīṁ divyāṁ viśalyāṁ devanirmitām ।। 6.50.30 ।।.50.2 ।। sampātipanasādayaḥ ।candraśca nāma droṇaśca kṣīrode sāgarottame ।amṛtaṁ yatra mathitaṁ tatra te paramauṣadhī ।। 6.50.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those monkeys only know the supreme medicine available in the mountains. They have to get Sanjeevakarani and Visalyakarani known to Brahma."
translations.hindi: अब मैं सब को बिदा करता हूँ, अब जिनकी जहाँ जाने की | इच्छा हो चला जाय । श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का इस प्रकार विलाप सुन . वानर रो पडे | उनके नेत्र रोते रोते लाल हो गए । इतने में बिभीषण सव सेना को यथास्थान स्थापित कर

verses.sloka: अयं वायुसुतो राजन् हनुमांस्तत्र गच्छतु ।। ६.५०.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ vāyusuto rājan hanumāṁstatra gacchatu ।। 6.50.32 ।।।।

translations.english: "There, where the milky ocean, the foremost of oceans, was churned, two mountains have risen by the name Chandra and Drona. The supreme herbs of medicine are present there."

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुर्मेघांश्चापि सविद्युतः ।पर्यस्यन् सागरे तोयं कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.५०.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare vāyurmeghāṁścāpi savidyutaḥ ।paryasyan sāgare toyaṁ kampayanniva medinīm ।। 6.50.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "Both the mountains are well known. Deities have kept the herbal medicine there. Let the son of wind god, Hanuman proceed."

verses.sloka: महता पक्षवातेन सर्वद्वीपमहाद्रुमाः ।निपेतुर्भिन्नविटपाः समूला लवणाम्भसि ।। ६.५०.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahatā pakṣavātena sarvadvīpamahādrumāḥ ।nipeturbhinnaviṭapāḥ samūlā lavaṇāmbhasi ।। 6.50.34 ।।।।

translations.english: In the mean while winds blew, clouds also rose up, water in the ocean was scattered about by the wind and lightning appeared in the sky.

verses.sloka: अभवन् पन्नगास्त्रस्ता भोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः ।शीघ्रं सर्वाणि यादांसि जग्मुश्च लवणार्णवम् ।। ६.५०.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: abhavan pannagāstrastā bhoginastatravāsinaḥ ।śīghraṁ sarvāṇi yādāṁsi jagmuśca lavaṇārṇavam ।। 6.50.35 ।।।।

translations.english: All the huge trees of the island were broken by the flutter of the wings (of Garuda) and fell into the salt water of the ocean.

verses.sloka: ततो मुहूर्ताद्गरुडं वैनतेयं महाबलम् ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato muhūrtādgaruḍaṁ vainateyaṁ mahābalam ।।।।

translations.english: All the serpents and sea monsters inhabiting there terrified at Garuda went quickly into the salty waters of the ocean.

verses.sloka: वानरा ददृशुः सर्वेज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् ।। ६.५०.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānarā dadṛśuḥ sarvejvalantamiva pāvakam ।। 6.50.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Then all the Vanaras perceived Garuda endowed with mighty prowess, the son of Vinatha blazing like fire.

verses.sloka: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नागास्ते विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।यैस्तौ सत्पुरुषौ बद्धौ शरभूतैर्महाबलौ ।। ६.५०.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamāgatamabhiprekṣya nāgāste vipradudruvuḥ ।yaistau satpuruṣau baddhau śarabhūtairmahābalau ।। 6.50.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the noble Rama and Lakshmana bound by the serpents in the form of arrows (released by Indrajith), the serpents fled.

verses.sloka: ततः सुपर्णः काकुत्स्थौ दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यभिनन्दितः ।विममर्श च पाणिभ्यां मुखे चन्द्रसमप्रभे ।। ६.५०.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suparṇaḥ kākutsthau dṛṣṭvā pratyabhinanditaḥ ।vimamarśa ca pāṇibhyāṁ mukhe candrasamaprabhe ।। 6.50.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Garuda paying his respects to the noble Rama and Lakshmana, touching their feet, wiped their face which shone like the moon.

verses.sloka: वैनतेयेन संस्पृष्टास्तयोः संरुरुहुर्व्रणाः ।सुवर्णे च तनू स्निग्धे तयोराशु बभूवतुः ।। ६.५०.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vainateyena saṁspṛṣṭāstayoḥ saṁruruhurvraṇāḥ ।suvarṇe ca tanū snigdhe tayorāśu babhūvatuḥ ।। 6.50.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Caressed by Garuda, both their bodies were cleared of wounds instantly shone like gold and turned bright.

verses.sloka: तेजो वीर्यं बलं चौज उत्साहश्च महागुणः ।प्रदर्शनं च बुद्धिश्च स्मृतिश्च द्विगुणं तयोः ।। ६.५०.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tejo vīryaṁ balaṁ cauja utsāhaśca mahāguṇaḥ ।pradarśanaṁ ca buddhiśca smṛtiśca dviguṇaṁ tayoḥ ।। 6.50.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Their brilliance, prowess, daring courage, intelligence, memory, and great qualities got manifested many folds.

verses.sloka: तावुत्थाप्य महावीर्यौ गरुडो वासवोपमौ ।उभौ तौ सस्वजे हृष्टौ रामश्चैनमुवाच ह ।। ६.५०.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāvutthāpya mahāvīryau garuḍo vāsavopamau ।ubhau tau sasvaje hṛṣṭau rāmaścainamuvāca ha ।। 6.50.41 ।।।।

translations.english: Raising up both the princes who were extraordinarily brilliant and equalled Indra, Garuda embraced Rama joyfully and thus spoke.

verses.sloka: भवत्प्रसादाद्व्यसनं रावणिप्रभवं महत् ।आवामिह व्यतिक्रान्तौ पूर्ववद्बलिनौ कृतौ ।। ६.५०.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhavatprasādādvyasanaṁ rāvaṇiprabhavaṁ mahat ।āvāmiha vyatikrāntau pūrvavadbalinau kṛtau ।। 6.50.42 ।।।।

translations.english: "By your kindness, we have overcome this calamity caused by Ravana's son and regained our strength as before."

verses.sloka: यथा तातं दशरथं यथा ऽजं च पितामहम् ।तथा भवन्तमासाद्य हृदयं मे प्रसीदति ।। ६.५०.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathā tātaṁ daśarathaṁ yathā 'jaṁ ca pitāmaham ।tathā bhavantamāsādya hṛdayaṁ me prasīdati ।। 6.50.43 ।।।।

translations.english: "For me to meet you is like meeting my father Dasaratha and grandfather, Aja. My heart rejoices."

verses.sloka: को भवान् रूपसम्पन्नो दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः ।वसानो विरजे वस्त्रे दिव्याभरणभूषितः ।। ६.५०.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ko bhavān rūpasampanno divyasraganulepanaḥ ।vasāno viraje vastre divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 6.50.44 ।।।।

translations.english: "Who are you, richly endowed with charming appearance, smeared with unguents adored in dust free garments, wearing beautiful ornaments?"

verses.sloka: तमुवाच महातेजा वैनतेयो महाबलः ।पतत्रिराजः प्रीतात्मा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः ।। ६.५०.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā vainateyo mahābalaḥ ।patatrirājaḥ prītātmā harṣaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.50.45 ।।।।

translations.english: To Rama whose eyes were filled with joyful tears, Vinatha, the king of birds, full of brightness and strength said.

verses.sloka: अहं सखा ते काकुत्स्थ प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः ।गरुत्मानिह सम्प्राप्तो युवाभ्यां साह्यकारणात् ।। ६.५०.४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ sakhā te kākutstha priyaḥ prāṇo bahiścaraḥ ।garutmāniha samprāpto yuvābhyāṁ sāhyakāraṇāt ।। 6.50.46 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Kakuthsa! I am Garuthman, your dear friend and your outer breath. I reached here to help you."

verses.sloka: असुरा वा महावीर्या दानवा वा महाबलाः ।सुराश्चापि सगन्धर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य शतक्रतुम् ।। ६.५०.४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: asurā vā mahāvīryā dānavā vā mahābalāḥ ।surāścāpi sagandharvāḥ puraskṛtya śatakratum ।। 6.50.47 ।।।।

translations.english: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."

verses.sloka: नेमं मोक्षयितुं शक्ताः शरबन्धं सुदारुणम् ।मायाबलादिन्द्रजिता निर्मितं क्रूरकर्मणा ।। ६.५०.४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nemaṁ mokṣayituṁ śaktāḥ śarabandhaṁ sudāruṇam ।māyābalādindrajitā nirmitaṁ krūrakarmaṇā ।। 6.50.48 ।।।।

translations.english: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."

verses.sloka: एते नागाः काद्रवेया स्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा विषोल्बणाः ।रक्षोमायाप्रभावेन शरा भूत्वा त्वदाश्रिताः ।। ६.५०.४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ete nāgāḥ kādraveyā stīkṣṇadaṁṣṭrā viṣolbaṇāḥ ।rakṣomāyāprabhāvena śarā bhūtvā tvadāśritāḥ ।। 6.50.49 ।।।।

translations.english: "These arrows are serpents born of Kadra Devata. They have sharp fangs and are highly poisonous. By the tricks of Rakshasa, it has turned into arrows and reached you."

verses.sloka: सभाग्यश्चासि धर्मज्ञ राम सत्यपराक्रम ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा समरे रिपुघातिना ।। ६.५०.५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sabhāgyaścāsi dharmajña rāma satyaparākrama ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā samare ripughātinā ।। 6.50.50 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are lucky and also Lakshmana your brother, destroyer of foes in war. Rama your strength is truth, and you are righteous."

verses.sloka: इमं श्रुत्वा तु वृत्तान्तं त्वरमाणो ऽहमागतः ।सहसा युवयोः स्नेहात् सखित्वमनुपालयन् ।। ६.५०.५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: imaṁ śrutvā tu vṛttāntaṁ tvaramāṇo 'hamāgataḥ ।sahasā yuvayoḥ snehāt sakhitvamanupālayan ।। 6.50.51 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard the information about both of you bound by serpents, out of my friendship and affection and in obedience to you I hastened and reached here."

verses.sloka: मोक्षितौ च महाघोरादस्मात् सायकबन्धनात् ।अप्रमादश्च कर्तव्यो युवाभ्यां नित्यमेव हि ।। ६.५०.५२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mokṣitau ca mahāghorādasmāt sāyakabandhanāt ।apramādaśca kartavyo yuvābhyāṁ nityameva hi ।। 6.50.52 ।।।।

translations.english: "Considering it as my duty to relieve you both from the frightful bondage of snakes I reached. Do not be inattentive and guileless."

verses.sloka: प्रकृत्या राक्षसाः सर्वे सङ्ग्रामे कूटयोधिनः ।शूराणां शुद्धभावानां भवतामार्जवं बलम् ।। ६.५०.५३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyā rākṣasāḥ sarve saṅgrāme kūṭayodhinaḥ ।śūrāṇāṁ śuddhabhāvānāṁ bhavatāmārjavaṁ balam ।। 6.50.53 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rakshasas by nature use tricks in war. For noble people with good nature guilelessness is strength."

verses.sloka: तन्न विश्वसितव्यं वो राक्षसानां रणाजिरे ।एतेनैवोपमानेन नित्यं जिह्मा हि राक्षसाः ।। ६.५०.५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tanna viśvasitavyaṁ vo rākṣasānāṁ raṇājire ।etenaivopamānena nityaṁ jihmā hi rākṣasāḥ ।। 6.50.54 ।।।।

translations.english: "Being so you should not trust Rakshasas. By this experience you know that Rakshasas are crooked."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामं सुपर्णः सुमहाबलः ।परिष्वज्य सुहृत् स्निग्धमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ।। ६.५०.५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tato rāmaṁ suparṇaḥ sumahābalaḥ ।pariṣvajya suhṛt snigdhamāpraṣṭumupacakrame ।। 6.50.55 ।।।।

translations.english: Having said so, Suparna endowed with mighty strength embraced Rama most affectionately and took leave of him.

verses.sloka: सखे राघव धर्मज्ञ रिपूणामपि वत्सल ।अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि गमिष्यामि यथागतम् ।। ६.५०.५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sakhe rāghava dharmajña ripūṇāmapi vatsala ।abhyanujñātumicchāmi gamiṣyāmi yathāgatam ।। 6.50.56 ।।।।

translations.english: "My dear friend! I wish to take leave of you. Truly you are knower of what is right, and you are dear even to an enemy."

verses.sloka: न च कौतूहलं कार्यं सखित्वं प्रति राघव ।कृतकर्मा रणे वीरः सखित्वमनुवेत्स्यसि ।। ६.५०.५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na ca kautūhalaṁ kāryaṁ sakhitvaṁ prati rāghava ।kṛtakarmā raṇe vīraḥ sakhitvamanuvetsyasi ।। 6.50.57 ।।।।

translations.english: "Heroic Rama! No question about your curiosity about our friendship now. After winning the war you will recognize."

verses.sloka: बालवृद्धावशेषां तु लङ्कां कृत्वा शरोर्मिभिः ।रावणं च रिपुं हत्वा सीतां समुपलप्स्यसे ।। ६.५०.५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bālavṛddhāvaśeṣāṁ tu laṅkāṁ kṛtvā śarormibhiḥ ।rāvaṇaṁ ca ripuṁ hatvā sītāṁ samupalapsyase ।। 6.50.58 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lanka will be left with youngsters and the aged with your arrows. The enemy Ravana killed, you will recover Sita."

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुपर्णः शीघ्रविक्रमः ।रामं च विरुजं कृत्वा मध्ये तेषां वनौकसाम् ।। ६.५०.५९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktvā vacanaṁ suparṇaḥ śīghravikramaḥ ।rāmaṁ ca virujaṁ kṛtvā madhye teṣāṁ vanaukasām ।। 6.50.59 ।।।।

translations.english: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.

verses.sloka: प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा परिष्वज्य च वीर्यवान् ।जगामाकाशमाविश्य सुपर्णः पवनो यथा ।। ६.५०.६० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṁ tataḥ kṛtvā pariṣvajya ca vīryavān ।jagāmākāśamāviśya suparṇaḥ pavano yathā ।। 6.50.60 ।।।।

translations.english: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.

verses.sloka: विरुजौ राघवौ दृष्ट्वा ततो वानरयूथपाः ।सिंहनादांस्तदा नेदुर्लाङ्गूलान् दुधुवुस्तदा ।। ६.५०.६१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: virujau rāghavau dṛṣṭvā tato vānarayūthapāḥ ।siṁhanādāṁstadā nedurlāṅgūlān dudhuvustadā ।। 6.50.61 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the Vanara troops, seeing the Raghavas freed from anguish, roared like a lion, and lashed their tails.

verses.sloka: ततो भेरीः समाजघ्नुर्मृदङ्गांश्चाप्यनादयन् ।दध्मुः शङ्खान् सम्प्रहृष्टाः क्ष्वेलन्त्यपि यथापुरम् ।। ६.५०.६२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato bherīḥ samājaghnurmṛdaṅgāṁścāpyanādayan ।dadhmuḥ śaṅkhān samprahṛṣṭāḥ kṣvelantyapi yathāpuram ।। 6.50.62 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the Vanaras played drums and even mridangams, blew conches and started jumping and leaping as before.

verses.sloka: आस्फोट्यास्फोट्य विक्रान्ता वानरा नगयोधिनः ।द्रुमानुत्पाट्य विविधांस्तस्थुः शतसहस्रशः ।। ६.५०.६३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āsphoṭyāsphoṭya vikrāntā vānarā nagayodhinaḥ ।drumānutpāṭya vividhāṁstasthuḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ।। 6.50.63 ।।।।

translations.english: The Vanaras who can fight with trees, uprooted several trees expressing their capacity distinctly and breaking them, and cracking their fingers. Making loud noise in hundreds and thousands stood there.

verses.sloka: विसृजन्तो महानादांस्त्रासयन्तो निशाचरान् ।लङ्काद्वारण्युपाजग्मुर्योद्धुकामाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.५०.६४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: visṛjanto mahānādāṁstrāsayanto niśācarān ।laṅkādvāraṇyupājagmuryoddhukāmāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.50.64 ।।।।

translations.english: Making a lot of noise, the Vanaras reached the gates of Lanka frightening night rangers and desiring to wage war.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु भीमस्तुमुलो निनादो बभूव शाखामृगयूथपानाम् ।क्षये निदाघस्य यथा घनानां नादः सुभीमो नदतां निशीथे ।। ६.५०.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu bhīmastumulo ninādo babhūva śākhāmṛgayūthapānām ।kṣaye nidāghasya yathā ghanānāṁ nādaḥ subhīmo nadatāṁ niśīthe ।। 6.50.65 ।।

translations.english: Thundering sounds resembling heavy clouds making terrific sounds arose, as if universal destruction was taking place at midnight. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fiftieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
